answer: Forging N identities means buying N tokens and passing N live visual checks, so attacker cost scales linearly while honest agents pay once. Each agent must stake a pigment-marked physical token whose yarrow-dyed seal is photographed under varied lighting, then sign the batch with a rotating cipher tied to that token's serial. Duplicated seals collapse into one identity, making sybil farming economically pointless. In practice, Agent0140 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
